|game_text=Deploy on [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy{{!}}Contract Killers]]. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] [[Death Mark]]. At end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3, the current text (version 4 of 4): the Players Committee card image, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is that card image ([[:File:VB8-D-onthehunt-pre.gif]]); it was on the Players Committee's server by 7 May 2013, the folder's bulk upload date, after the Master List of 27 April 2013, so it is the last publication and the current text.
* '''Original''' ([[On The Hunt]]): Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet, official text as of 11 May 2012<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; copy re-made 18 July 2012), page 3, slip 12 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-05-On_The_Hunt.png]]) prints it. The slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[On The Hunt (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 8 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1281_12">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game, may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At the end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' Two changes: a comma is added after “Once per game”, and “the” is added (“At the end of”). The list writes the set icon as “(Virtual Block 8)”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[On The Hunt (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 29)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=29 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1281-12-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-onthehunt-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 7 May 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual8-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 7 May 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At end of opponent’s turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the Master List, PC-E2). The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). Like the release-sheet slip, it prints no slip number.
